competing_hypotheses.claim: SMFG's 5% participation and customer distribution capabilities will materially expand JPYSC use.
support: Official 5% capital participation and joint use-case/PoC program.
Secondary report cites approximately 24M SMBC individual customers.
counter: No active service, user count, balances by channel or settlement volumes are disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: No material JPYSC balance or transaction growth after launch of any SMBC distribution channel.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's broader financial ecosystem can increase XRP access while stablecoin rails simultaneously reduce XRP's role as a JPY/USD bridge.
support: Bitbank ownership, XRP reward products, SBI VC Trade XRP access and XRPL technical work.
JPYSC/OUSD interoperability and RLUSD/USDC distribution create alternative stablecoin rails.
counter: No production JPYSC/OUSD route or measured bridge substitution exists.
Stablecoins and XRP may serve different legs/use cases.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Production settlement data shows XRP is the dominant bridge in the relevant JPY/USD routes, or stablecoin routes remain unused.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The planned SBI Shinsei Trust/SBI Clearing Trust merger will strengthen regulated digital-asset custody and stablecoin backing capabilities.
support: SBI Clearing Trust has a crypto-asset trust custody business; SBI Shinsei Trust issues JPYSC.
Official merger agreement and December 31 planned effective date.
counter: No XRP-specific custody acceptance or balance is disclosed.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Regulatory approval fails, merger is delayed, or the surviving entity does not add crypto-asset custody scope.

competing_hypotheses.claim: bitbank-lab-mcp can provide Barrot with a useful Japanese XRP/JPY public market-data feed and reproducible baseline analysis.
support: Local MCP beta and public tools for ticker, order book, candles, transactions, CVD/flow and volatility.
Documented intended support for Claude Desktop, Codex and Gemini CLI.
counter: No Barrot connection or live API call tested.
Experimental beta, inconsistent tool counts and package version metadata.
Single-venue data cannot substitute for synchronized multi-venue market data.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Public XRP/JPY tools fail deterministic schema/time-quality tests or cannot be pinned to a stable release.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI's completed bitbank acquisition increases group control over Japanese XRP/JPY liquidity and customer distribution.
support: Third-party snapshot shows approximately USD7.54M 24h XRP/JPY volume and 0.01% spread.
counter: Only one third-party snapshot; no pre/post acquisition baseline or market-share panel.
Exchange volume and custody balances do not equal net XRP demand.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: Post-acquisition XRP/JPY volume, depth and customer balances show no durable change after controlling for market-wide volume.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI/Startale's Open Standard participation creates an indirect ecosystem connection to Coinbase but does not establish a direct Circle partnership.
support: SBI/Startale joined Open Standard and are exploring JPYSC/OUSD.
Coinbase is named among five founding partners of Open Standard.
counter: The wider participant network may include other firms; absence from the five founders is not proof of no participation.
No direct SBI/Circle agreement or XRP settlement route is identified.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_test: A direct Circle-SBI/SMFG agreement or production Circle-issued USDC integration into the JPYSC/OUSD route is documented.

limitations: SBI's October 30 official release confirms SMFG's 5% capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing and joint research/PoC work, but does not establish production JPYSC settlement, transaction volume, customer adoption or any XRP role.

The approximately 24 million SMBC individual-customer figure and approximately JPY20.8B JPYSC issuance figure as of October 30 are secondary reporting citing Nikkei in this capture; the official SBI release confirms the 5% participation but not those two metrics. Customer base is not adoption, and the current supply figure lacks independent on-chain reconciliation here.

The SBI Shinsei Trust/SBI Clearing Trust merger is planned for December 31, 2026 and is not yet effective. The announcement describes general crypto-asset trust custody and JPYSC issuance, not XRP-specific custody, balances or acceptance.

bitbank-lab-mcp is an experimental local beta. No Barrot installation, live API call, platform authentication or adapter handoff was executed. Named Claude/Codex/Gemini clients are intended compatibility targets, not proof of live connections.

bitbank-lab-mcp documentation conflicts on public tool count (32 versus 33), and package.json version 0.0.0-dev differs from gemini-extension.json 0.1.1. Release metadata and tool manifests must be reconciled before a production adapter pins a version.

bitbank-lab-mcp private account/order tools require an API key and secret; order operations need trade permission. The recommended Barrot design is public-only with no credentials. The optional MCP Apps _meta execution path is default-off and depends on host behavior not guaranteed by the protocol.

The bitbank XRP/JPY 24-hour volume, spread and depth values are a third-party single snapshot captured around 08:05 UTC without an exact exchange timestamp. They are venue context, not a synchronized multi-venue feature and are not admitted to the prediction engine.

The SBI stablecoin, custody and XRP distribution relationships do not establish that XRP is used as the bridge in JPYSC/OUSD interoperability, BlackRock tokenized-MMF settlement, SMFG financial services or the planned trust structure.
